spec.prompt: Medium close-up of the Lydian from reference image 1 (crested bronze helmet pushed up, braids, short beard, crimson tunic, bronze scale corselet, crimson lion shield), standing in the shallows, body three-quarters toward frame right. A Median wicker shield held up just outside frame right breaks the low golden sunlight into a field of many small bright spots of light that dapple his bronze scales, his shield and his face, gently shimmering. 0-1.5 s he breathes in a fighting stance; at 1.8 s he notices the strange spotted light on his chest and glances down at it, puzzled; at 2.8 s he slowly lifts his face toward the sky at frame right and stares up. The light is low and golden but slightly flat and cool, the background dark. Camera static, slight push-in. Photoreal live-action cinema, crisp focus, high shutter speed with no motion blur. Clear air. Nobody sings or speaks; the audio is only background music for timing. Reference images are identity, costume and location references only: never show the grey studio, the turnaround layout or the inset panels. No text, no watermark.
spec.notes: The renderer paints the stretched crescent suns; the plate gives the dappled light, the glance down and the look up.
